candidates.name: Toolset
candidates.rationale: Reusable maintenance equipment fits trusted field logistics and does not itself grant ammunition, access or combat capability.

candidates.name: Weapon repair kit
candidates.rationale: A scarce finite maintenance resource gives relationship progression practical value without replacing quest-gated capability unlocks.

candidates.name: Body armor repair kit
candidates.rationale: Role fit is strong but the pinned reference value is an order of magnitude above lower-tier maintenance stock; it must not be added before explicit Economy Admiral supply/price review and vanilla overlap proof.

candidates.name: Leatherman Multitool
candidates.rationale: Current vanilla already exposes the multitool as early Mechanic stock; adding it as relationship progression would create low-value duplicate availability rather than a meaningful Admiral privilege.

candidates.name: Signal Jammer
candidates.rationale: Current vanilla exposes the jammer through Mechanic and uses it directly in quest placement flows; duplicating it as Admiral relationship stock adds little specialist identity and risks becoming quest convenience stock.
